title: Neural Media Bias Detection Using Distant Supervision With BABE - Bias Annotations By Experts

bias_targets.methodology: Creating an expert-annotated dataset (BABE) of sentences from US news outlets across the political spectrum (left-wing, center, and right-wing), and evaluating Transformer-based models (e.g., BERT, RoBERTa) fine-tuned on this data using a distant supervision pre-training step based on partisan vs. non-partisan news headlines.
